Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description: Represents an initial interest form submission from a potential customer.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment or note made by an admin on a record.

authorId.description: The ID of the admin user who wrote the comment.

authorName.description: The display name of the admin who wrote the comment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

Advertisement.title: Advertisement
Advertisement.description: Represents an advertisement record and its lifecycle status.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this ad.

subscriptionId.description: The Stripe subscription ID associated with this ad.

status.description: The current stage of the ad in the workflow.

AdSubscription.title: AdSubscription
AdSubscription.description: Represents an ad subscription for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ad subscription.

userId.description: Reference to the User. (Relationship: User 1:N AdSubscription)

adCampaignId.description: Reference to the AdCampaign. (Relationship: AdCampaign 1:N AdSubscription)

subscriptionType.description: The duration of the subscription (monthly, quarterly, yearly).

price.description: The price of the ad subscription.

AdCampaign.title: AdCampaign
AdCampaign.description: Represents an ad campaign and its pricing on a community website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ad campaign.

websiteId.description: Reference to the CommunityWebsite. (Relationship: CommunityWebsite 1:N AdCampaign)

monthlyPrice.description: The monthly price for the ad campaign.

quarterlyPrice.description: The quarterly price for the ad campaign.

yearlyPrice.description: The yearly price for the ad campaign.

description.description: A description of the ad campaign.

CommunityWebsite.title: CommunityWebsite
CommunityWebsite.description: Represents a community website on which ads can be placed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the community website.

name.description: The name of the community website.

url.description: The URL of the community website.

description.description: A description of the community website.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the system, including their ad submission details.

email.description: The email address of the user.

stripeLink.description: A link to the user's Stripe customer portal.

businessName.description: The user's business name for the ad.

adWebsiteUrl.description: The website URL the ad should link to.

adText.description: The main text or slogan for the ad banner.

adNotes.description: Any additional notes, offers, or instructions for the ad design.

Mail.title: Mail
Mail.description: Represents an email to be sent by the Trigger Email extension.

EmailTemplate.title: EmailTemplate
EmailTemplate.description: Stores editable templates for automated emails.

name.description: A user-friendly name for the template (e.g., 'Welcome Email').

description.description: A brief explanation of when this email is sent.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

html.description: The HTML body of the email. Can contain placeholders.

triggerName.description: A programmatic name for the trigger (e.g., 'interest_form_submission').

triggerDescription.description: A human-readable description of what triggers the email.

placeholders.description: An array of available placeholders for this template.

description.description: A description of what the placeholder represents.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to adhere to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs, ensuring secure and scalable data management for the Community-Websites application. It leverages structural segregation and denormalization to optimize security rules and database operations.

*   **Leads**: A new top-level `/leads` collection is introduced to capture interest form submissions from unauthenticated users. This collection is publicly writeable but only readable by admins, providing a secure inbox for new potential customers.
*   **Users:** User data is stored under `/users/{userId}`. This path-based ownership model simplifies security rules and provides clear ownership.
*   **Ad Subscriptions:** Ad subscriptions are stored under `/users/{userId}/adSubscriptions/{adSubscriptionId}`. This structure maintains a clear 1:N relationship between users and their ad subscriptions. The `userId` field within the `adSubscriptions` collection enforces the ownership invariant.
*   **Advertisements:** A new top-level `/advertisements` collection is introduced to serve as a 'ticket system' for managing the ad creation lifecycle. This collection is writeable only by a server-side process (like a Cloud Function triggered by a new subscription) and readable/writeable by admins. This separation provides a clean, secure, and scalable way to manage the operational workflow without mixing it with user-facing data.
*   **Community Websites:** Community websites are stored in the `/communityWebsites/{communityWebsiteId}` collection. This allows for global access to website information without requiring authorization checks, given that this information is intended to be public. If websites had owners or restricted data, a different approach would be taken.
*   **Ad Campaigns:** Ad campaigns are stored under `/communityWebsites/{websiteId}/adCampaigns/{adCampaignId}`. This maintains the 1:N relationship between community websites and ad campaigns. This structure ensures that only admins can modify ad campaigns, which is checked via a separate admin roles collection.
*   **Admin Roles:** Admin roles are managed through the `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection. The existence of a document in this collection grants admin privileges. This follows the Existence over Content strategy, simplifying role-based access control.
*   **Stripe Integration**: Added collections for Stripe payments (`/products`, `/customers`) as required by the `firestore-stripe-payments` extension.
*   **Email Trigger**: Added a `/mail` collection for the 'Trigger Email' extension.
*   **Email Templates**: Added a `/emailTemplates` collection for storing editable email templates, manageable only by admins.
